title: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sents.t: Susie Somori lives in a three-story house with lots of stairs and several rooms.
sents.zh: Susie Somori 住在一栋三层楼的房子里，楼梯很多，房间也不少。

sents.t: Out of all the rooms, there's one in particular that she stays away from.
sents.zh: 在所有房间里，有一间她特别躲着不去。

sents.t: On the third floor, there's a large vacant room with the painting of a sun on one of its walls.
sents.zh: 三楼有一间空荡荡的大房间，其中一面墙上画着一个太阳。

sents.t: She doesn't know why, but there's something about this painting that makes her feel very uneasy.
sents.zh: 她也不知道为什么，但这幅画总让她感到很不安。

sents.t: It might be the ambience of the room, but she can't help but feel like the painting is responsible for the dreaded feeling she gets whenever she walks in.
sents.zh: 也许是房间的氛围，但她总忍不住觉得，每次走进去时那种恐惧感，都是这幅画造成的。

sents.t: So, thinking it's all in her head, she tries her best to ignore this feeling.
sents.zh: 于是，她觉得这都是自己想多了，尽力不去理会这种感觉。

sents.t: But then, one night, Susie encounters something that scared the living daylights out of her.
sents.zh: 可有一天晚上，Susie 遇到了一件把她吓得魂飞魄散的事。

sents.t: Susie is home alone when she captures the following on camera.
sents.zh: Susie 一个人在家时，拍到了下面的画面。

sents.t: Susie ends the video there, but little does she know that things were about to get worse.
sents.zh: Susie 的视频到这里就结束了，但她没想到，事情还会变得更糟。

sents.t: One day, Susie's niece is playing inside the room, and while spying on her, she captures this.
sents.zh: 有一天，Susie 的侄女在那个房间里玩，Susie 偷偷看着她，拍到了这个。

sents.t: Her niece appears to be talking to the painting, as though she's having a conversation with it.
sents.zh: 侄女好像在和那幅画说话，就像在和它聊天一样。

sents.t: Susie didn't like this, and so she asked her as to who she was talking to.
sents.zh: Susie 不喜欢这样，于是问她在和谁说话。

sents.t: This is what she said.
sents.zh: 这是她的回答。

sents.t: Do you like him?
sents.zh: 你喜欢他吗？

sents.t: Yes. Gilbert's like one of my best friends.
sents.zh: 喜欢。Gilbert 就像我最好的朋友之一。

sents.t: Where did it come from?
sents.zh: 它是从哪儿来的？

sents.t: I don't know. I think the man that used to live here painted it.
sents.zh: 我不知道。我想是以前住在这里的那个人画的。

sents.t: Is Gilbert friendly? Does he speak to you?
sents.zh: Gilbert 友好吗？他会跟你说话吗？

sents.t: Yeah.
sents.zh: 会。

sents.t: What does he say?
sents.zh: 他说什么？

sents.t: Because I don't pray.
sents.zh: 因为我不祈祷。

sents.t: Susie doesn't know what to make of this.
sents.zh: Susie 不知道该怎么理解这件事。

sents.t: It seems that her niece had befriended Gilbert, the painting on the wall.
sents.zh: 看来侄女和墙上那幅画“Gilbert”交上了朋友。

sents.t: She's made an imaginary friend.
sents.zh: 她有了一个想象中的朋友。

sents.t: But the things said by this so-called friend doesn't sit well with Susie.
sents.zh: 但这个所谓的“朋友”说的话，让 Susie 很不舒服。

sents.t: And so, she decides to spy on her once more.
sents.zh: 于是，她决定再偷偷观察她一次。

sents.t: But this time, she captures something even more strange.
sents.zh: 但这一次，她拍到了更奇怪的东西。

sents.t: Her niece appears to be looking for something underneath the floorboard.
sents.zh: 侄女好像在地板下面找什么东西。

sents.t: It was only after her niece had fallen asleep that she decided to investigate the spot.
sents.zh: 等侄女睡着后，她才决定去查看那个地方。

sents.t: She checks it out and ends up finding something disturbing.
sents.zh: 她去查看，结果发现了让人不安的东西。

sents.t: Take a look.
sents.zh: 来看看。

sents.t: Needless to say, Susie was speechless.
sents.zh: 不用说，Susie 惊得说不出话来。

sents.t: What's more strange about this is the Ouija board itself.
sents.zh: 更奇怪的是那块通灵板本身。

sents.t: If you look closely, the board appears to have the same painting of the sun that's on the wall.
sents.zh: 仔细看，通灵板上好像画着和墙上一模一样的太阳。

sents.t: This can't be a coincidence.
sents.zh: 这不可能是巧合。

sents.t: Susie is certain that the board is somehow connected to the painting.
sents.zh: Susie 确信这块板和那幅画之间有某种联系。

sents.t: This unsettling discovery has led Susie into researching the history of her home.
sents.zh: 这个令人不安的发现，让 Susie 开始调查这栋房子的历史。

sents.t: And after much research, she found this.
sents.zh: 经过大量调查，她找到了这个。

sents.t: Here is a photo of the house from 1916, and it was built in 1902.
sents.zh: 这是这栋房子 1916 年的照片，房子建于 1902 年。

sents.t: So this would be the first, or one of the first, families to live in this house.
sents.zh: 所以这应该是第一户，或者最早的几户住在这里的人家之一。

sents.t: As you can see, there are six people present in the photo.
sents.zh: 你可以看到，照片里有六个人。

sents.t: Looking at the English census records, I found that the father would be called John.
sents.zh: 查了英国的人口普查记录后，我发现父亲叫 John。

sents.t: The mother was called Maude. Next, round the balcony, is her daughter, Dorothy.
sents.zh: 母亲叫 Maude。接着，在阳台那边的是她的女儿 Dorothy。

sents.t: The birth of a little boy called Gilbert was also registered here in 1911, so he would be about five or six in this photo.
sents.zh: 1911 年这里还登记过一个叫 Gilbert 的小男孩出生，所以拍这张照片时他应该五六岁。

sents.t: I'm not sure why he's not with the rest of his family in the photo, or what they did to him.
sents.zh: 我不知道他为什么没和家里其他人一起出现在照片里，也不知道他们对他做了什么。

sents.t: I just have an overwhelming feeling that something really terrible happened to him at the hands of his own family.
sents.zh: 我就是有一种强烈的感觉：他的家人对他做了非常可怕的事。

sents.t: The weirdest part is that this is where the sun painting is situated in the house. That's his room.
sents.zh: 最诡异的是，太阳壁画就在房子的这个位置。那是他的房间。

sents.t: Gilbert was the name of a child who used to live in her house, and whose room has the painting of the sun, which seems to have been named after him.
sents.zh: Gilbert 是一个曾经住在她家里的孩子的名字，那间画着太阳的房间就是他的，而那幅画似乎就是以他命名的。

sents.t: She has yet to post more info on the history of her home.
sents.zh: 关于房子的历史，她还没有公布更多信息。

sents.t: For now, she continues researching in the hopes of putting an end to this mystery.
sents.zh: 目前，她还在继续调查，希望能解开这个谜团。

sents.t: Is Gilbert the supposed ghost that talks to her niece, or is it something else?
sents.zh: Gilbert 就是那个和她侄女说话的鬼吗，还是另有其物？
